WITH attempt_facts AS ( SELECT t.tenant_id AS tenant_id, t.account_id AS accountId, t.account_phone AS accountPhone, t.id AS targetId, a.id AS attemptId, a.status AS attemptStatus, a.reason_code AS reasonCode, a.reason_message AS reasonMessage, a.group_status AS rawGroupStatus, a.group_status_reason AS groupStatusReason, CASE WHEN a.status = 1 THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.group_status, ''))) IN ( 'NORMAL', 'BANNED', 'NO_PERMISSION' ) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.reason_code, ''))) IN ( 'ACCOUNT_BANNED', 'KICKED_OUT', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT', 'GROUP_BANNED', 'BANNED', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED', 'CHAT_TERMINATED', 'NO_PERMISSION', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN' ) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(a.group_status_reason, ''))) IN ( 'GROUP_SEND_ALLOWED', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED', 'CHAT_TERMINATED', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS effectiveGroupStatus, a.round_no AS roundNo, a.attempt_no AS attemptNo, COALESCE(a.result_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) AS eventAt, CASE WHEN a.round_no = 0 AND a.group_link_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), '') IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) END AS groupLinkId, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '') ) AS groupJid, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), CONCAT('link:', COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id)), CONCAT('target:', t.id) ) AS groupKey, CASE WHEN a.round_no = 0 AND a.group_link_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), '') IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url) END AS groupLinkUrl, CASE WHEN a.round_no = 0 AND a.group_link_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), '') IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), '') ) ELSE COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '') ) END AS groupName FROM marketing_task_target t JOIN marketing_task_send_attempt a ON a.target_id = t.id AND a.marketing_task_id = t.marketing_task_id LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN wa_group linked_group ON linked_group.id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND current_group.group_jid = COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(linked_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '') ) LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.group_id = current_group.id WHERE t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND a.status IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4) ), fixed_target_groups AS ( SELECT t.tenant_id AS tenant_id, t.account_id AS accountId, MAX(t.account_phone) AS accountPhone, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), ''), CONCAT('link:', t.group_link_id), CONCAT('target:', t.id) ) AS groupKey, MAX(t.group_link_id) AS groupLinkId, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), ''))) AS groupJid, MAX(COALESCE(g.link_url, t.group_link_url)) AS groupLinkUrl, MAX(COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.group_jid), '') )) AS groupName FROM marketing_task_target t LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = t.group_link_id LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.group_id = current_group.id WHERE t.marketing_task_id = #{taskId} AND COALESCE(t.target_scope, 1) = 1 GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.account_id, groupKey ), attempt_dimensions AS ( SELECT tenant_id, accountId, MAX(accountPhone) AS accountPhone, groupKey, MAX(groupLinkId) AS groupLinkId, MAX(groupJid) AS groupJid, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( groupLinkUrl ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupLinkUrl, SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( groupName ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ) AS groupName, SUM(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sentMessageCount, SUM(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedMessageCount, SUM(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skippedMessageCount, MAX(CASE WHEN attemptStatus IN (0, 1, 2, 3) THEN eventAt ELSE NULL END) AS lastAttemptAt, MAX(CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN eventAt ELSE NULL END) AS lastSentAt, NULLIF( SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN attemptStatus IN (2, 3) THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(reasonMessage), ''), reasonCode, CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 3 THEN '本轮已跳过' ELSE '发送失败' END ) WHEN attemptStatus = 1 THEN '' ELSE NULL END ORDER BY eventAt DESC, attemptId DESC SEPARATOR '
' ), '
', 1 ), '' ) AS lastReason FROM attempt_facts GROUP BY tenant_id, accountId, groupKey ), group_dimensions AS ( SELECT tenant_id, accountId, groupKey FROM fixed_target_groups UNION SELECT tenant_id, accountId, groupKey FROM attempt_dimensions ),
latest_protocol AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT protocol.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, accountId, groupKey ORDER BY effectiveGroupStatus DESC, roundNo DESC, attemptNo DESC, attemptId DESC ) AS protocolRank FROM attempt_facts protocol WHERE attemptStatus IN (1, 2) ) ranked WHERE ranked.protocolRank = 1 ), latest_ended AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT ended.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, accountId, groupKey ORDER BY CASE WHEN attemptStatus = 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, roundNo DESC, attemptNo DESC, attemptId DESC ) AS endedRank FROM attempt_facts ended WHERE attemptStatus IN (1, 2, 3, 4) ) ranked WHERE ranked.endedRank = 1 ) SELECT d.accountId, COALESCE(a.accountPhone, f.accountPhone) AS accountPhone, COALESCE(a.groupLinkId, f.groupLinkId) AS groupLinkId, COALESCE(a.groupJid, f.groupJid) AS groupJid, COALESCE(a.groupLinkUrl, f.groupLinkUrl) AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(a.groupName, f.groupName) AS groupName, CASE self_participant.presence_status WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN CASE self_participant.last_exit_type WHEN 'REMOVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ELSE NULL END AS membershipStatus, protocol.attemptStatus AS latestAttemptStatus, protocol.reasonCode AS reasonCode, protocol.reasonMessage AS reasonMessage, protocol.rawGroupStatus AS groupStatus, protocol.groupStatusReason AS groupStatusReason, ended.attemptStatus AS latestExecutionStatus, ended.reasonCode AS executionReasonCode, ended.reasonMessage AS executionReasonMessage, ended.rawGroupStatus AS executionGroupStatus, ended.groupStatusReason AS executionGroupStatusReason, COALESCE(a.sentMessageCount, 0) AS sentMessageCount, COALESCE(a.failedMessageCount, 0) AS failedMessageCount, COALESCE(a.skippedMessageCount, 0) AS skippedMessageCount, a.lastAttemptAt, a.lastSentAt, a.lastReason FROM group_dimensions d LEFT JOIN fixed_target_groups f ON f.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND f.accountId = d.accountId AND f.groupKey = d.groupKey LEFT JOIN attempt_dimensions a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.accountId = d.accountId AND a.groupKey = d.groupKey LEFT JOIN latest_protocol protocol ON protocol.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND protocol.accountId = d.accountId AND protocol.groupKey = d.groupKey LEFT JOIN latest_ended ended ON ended.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ended.accountId = d.accountId AND ended.groupKey = d.groupKey LEFT JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND current_group.group_jid = COALESCE(a.groupJid, f.groupJid) LEFT JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND binding.account_id = d.accountId AND binding.group_id = current_group.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id ORDER BY d.accountId ASC, CASE WHEN ended.attemptStatus = 4 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, COALESCE(a.lastAttemptAt, 0) DESC, d.groupKey ASC

SELECT COALESCE(a.group_link_id, resolved_handle.id, #{target.groupLinkId}) AS groupLinkId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(effective_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(jid_group.group_jid), ''), #{target.groupJid}) AS groupJid, COALESCE( CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(#{target.groupLinkUrl})) LIKE 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/%' AND COALESCE(a.group_link_id, resolved_handle.id, #{target.groupLinkId}, -1) = COALESCE(#{target.groupLinkId}, -1) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(effective_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(jid_group.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{target.groupJid}), ''), '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(#{target.groupJid}), ''), '') THEN TRIM(#{target.groupLinkUrl}) END, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(g.link_url)) LIKE 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/%' THEN TRIM(g.link_url) END, '') AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), current_profile.subject, #{target.groupName}) AS groupName FROM marketing_task_send_attempt a LEFT JOIN wa_group jid_group ON jid_group.group_jid = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(#{target.groupJid}), '')) LEFT JOIN group_link resolved_handle ON resolved_handle.tenant_id = jid_group.tenant_id AND resolved_handle.group_id = jid_group.id LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = COALESCE(a.group_link_id, resolved_handle.id, #{target.groupLinkId}) LEFT JOIN wa_group effective_group ON effective_group.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND effective_group.id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.tenant_id = COALESCE( effective_group.tenant_id, jid_group.tenant_id) AND current_profile.group_id = COALESCE(effective_group.id, jid_group.id) WHERE a.id = #{attemptId} AND a.target_id = #{target.id} ORDER BY resolved_handle.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_target SET group_link_id = COALESCE(#{snapshot.groupLinkId}, group_link_id), group_jid = COALESCE(#{snapshot.groupJid}, group_jid), group_link_url = COALESCE(#{snapshot.groupLinkUrl}, group_link_url), group_name = COALESCE(#{snapshot.groupName}, group_name), status = CASE WHEN failed_message_count > 0 THEN 5 ELSE 3 END, sent_message_count = sent_message_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{resultAt}, last_sent_at = #{resultAt}, last_reason = CASE WHEN failed_message_count > 0 THEN last_reason ELSE NULL END, updated_at = #{resultAt} WHERE id = #{targetId}

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, g.id AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, g.link_url AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), current_profile.subject) AS groupName, CASE self_participant.presence_status WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN CASE self_participant.last_exit_type WHEN 'REMOVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ELSE 2 END AS membershipStatus, COALESCE(self_participant.presence_observed_at, binding.last_observed_at) AS statusUpdatedAt FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id JOIN account_group_sync_state group_sync ON group_sync.account_id = a.id JOIN group_link g ON g.id = #{groupLinkId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.membership_state IN (2, 3) JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.id = g.group_id AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.account_id = a.id AND binding.group_id = current_group.id JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.group_id = current_group.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state = 2 AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND group_sync.baseline_state IN (2, 3) AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND self_participant.presence_status IN (0, 1) AND (current_profile.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(current_profile.banned, 0) = 0 AND (current_profile.health_status IS NULL OR current_profile.health_status = 1))) AND ( group_sync.baseline_state <> 2 OR binding.was_in_initial_baseline IS NULL OR binding.was_in_initial_baseline = 0 ) LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS accountPhone, NULL AS groupLinkId, current_group.group_jid AS groupJid, NULL AS groupLinkUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(current_profile.subject), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_group.display_name), '')) AS groupName, CASE self_participant.presence_status WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN CASE self_participant.last_exit_type WHEN 'REMOVED' THEN 3 WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ELSE 2 END AS membershipStatus, COALESCE(self_participant.presence_observed_at, binding.last_observed_at) AS statusUpdatedAt FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id JOIN account_group_sync_state group_sync ON group_sync.account_id = a.id JOIN wa_group current_group ON current_group.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND current_group.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.account_id = a.id AND binding.group_id = current_group.id JOIN wa_group_participant self_participant ON self_participant.group_id = binding.group_id AND self_participant.id = binding.participant_id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile current_profile ON current_profile.group_id = current_group.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state = 2 AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND group_sync.baseline_state IN (2, 3) AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND self_participant.presence_status IN (0, 1) AND (current_profile.id IS NULL OR (COALESCE(current_profile.banned, 0) = 0 AND (current_profile.health_status IS NULL OR current_profile.health_status = 1))) AND ( group_sync.baseline_state <> 2 OR binding.was_in_initial_baseline IS NULL OR binding.was_in_initial_baseline = 0 ) LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, group_sync.baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, NULL AS baselineGroupJidsJson, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState, s.risk_status AS riskStatus, s.mute_status AS muteStatus, COALESCE(gm.groupCount, 0) AS groupCount FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_sync_state group_sync ON group_sync.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT binding.account_id, COUNT(*) AS groupCount FROM wa_account_group_binding binding GROUP BY binding.account_id ) gm ON gm.account_id = a.id WHERE a.account_group_id = #{groupId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.login_state = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.id ASC

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, group_sync.baseline_state AS groupBaselineState, NULL AS baselineGroupJidsJson, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState, s.risk_status AS riskStatus, s.mute_status AS muteStatus, COALESCE(gm.groupCount, 0) AS groupCount FROM account a LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN account_group_sync_state group_sync ON group_sync.account_id = a.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT binding.account_id, COUNT(*) AS groupCount FROM wa_account_group_binding binding GROUP BY binding.account_id ) gm ON gm.account_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
